name: Temple Guardians

features.name: Three money colours
features.description: Purple, green and blue symbols with stacking values.

features.name: Respin feature
features.description: Three respins that reset with each money symbol.

features.name: Full-grid prize
features.description: Filling the grid awards an extra 2,000x.

review:
Bears, wolves and owls paying up to 200x in the base game. Five or more money symbols trigger a respin with three colours of money symbol.

Purple carries values up to 500x, green is worth the total of all purple symbols on screen, and blue combines all purple and green values. Three respins reset with each new money symbol, and filling the grid adds 2,000x. The layers make every respin interesting. Up to 10,000x, 96.53% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
